objective: Preserve E520 v6 identity/fold/resource/profile checks while reusing each exact initial raw parquet digest during the same worker's portable registry verification, avoiding duplicate 35 GB raw reads.

input_identity.portable_manifest_env: Set WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST only after staged registry bytes and expected SHA are durably checked, as implemented in the unchanged v6 worker.

digest_handoff.initial_hash: Hash raw train and valid once with existing page-aligned POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED advice. Preserve the v6 before/after memory.stat and hash-progress receipts.
digest_handoff.authorization: Authorize only the handoff-issued receipt whose SHA-256 equals both the fixed expected raw digest and the already verified portable registry digest, whose byte count matches stat size, and whose descriptor/path stat identity stayed unchanged.
digest_handoff.scope: Exact canonical train/valid paths in this worker process only; no persisted or cross-attempt cache.
digest_handoff.consumer: Wrap only the pinned wnn.portability._content_digest after verifying module path and source SHA. The pinned portable registry and split loader continue their own source metadata and digest comparisons. Other paths and any stale/missing/mutated raw path fall through to the original pinned full content hash.
digest_handoff.observability: Record per-raw-path portable verifier lookup, exact-stat hit/miss, and original full-hash fallback counts in input_identity.json and memory_stat_phases.json after load_campaign_split.
digest_handoff.integrity_failure: Persist expected and observed input identities before a mismatch abort; never suppress a failed hash, fadvise, registry comparison, or split-membership check.

v6_measured_cost_basis.runtime_interpretation: v6 hit its 1800 s wall cap during the duplicate valid pass. One full repeated train pass is measured; the valid repeat's exact partial bytes are unknown. These timings motivate removing only the redundant same-worker digest pass; they are not profile or fit runtime estimates.

limits.new_cap_reason: Separate execution version for current remaining E520 profile quota; <=1700 seconds leaves reserve under the currently reported 3522.618 quota seconds after a 2x physical-T4 reservation.
limits.gpu_telemetry: Before and during trainer.main, sample all nvidia-smi physical rows every 5 seconds, maximum 24 samples, 2-second subprocess timeout. Preserve index/name/driver/UUID/memory and utilization columns; N/A/query errors stay null or diagnostic, never zero. Torch visibility remains exactly one selected device.

pre_execution_gates.external_review: exact independent receipt must bind current worker, helper, builder, bundle, tests, plan, and source archive hashes
pre_execution_gates.controller_admission: fresh quota/provider/runtime/resource receipt; current budget after reserve; worker <=1700s; one T4
pre_execution_gates.input_refresh: mounted bytes and hashes, portable manifest, fold split and target cache identities must pass before reuse authorization
pre_execution_gates.output_validation: offline self-contained bundle checks and actual downloaded files required after any future run
pre_execution_gates.score: not part of this profile-only candidate
